scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.build:electron: tsup electron/main/index.ts electron/preload/index.ts --out-dir dist-electron --format cjs --no-dts --clean --external electron --external electron-store
scripts.build: npm run build:next && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
